Unidentified aerial target north of Snake Island prompts alert near Romania

27 August 2026 · North of Snake Island

Nearby air alert — NOT a confirmed EU incursion

On 27 August 2026 an aerial target was reported over the Black Sea 33 km north of Snake Island, near the Ukrainian Black Sea sector. It was detected on radar, and two Spanish F-18 fighters were scrambled in a NATO response on the Romanian side. The exact time has not been established.

The target's full identity as a drone (UAV) has not been established, and its origin is unknown. It was reported outside demonstrated Romanian airspace and no entry into Romania was established, so the alert is not a confirmed incursion into the EU.

No impact in Romania was established. The alert was reported alongside coverage of a maritime incident involving the Progress IV, whose impact mechanism is unknown, but no causal link between the two has been shown. The alert is not evidence of what caused the Progress IV incident.
